retired_rows.label: spacr.qt.shortcuts#14
retired_rows.source: Every window-wide key can be rebound. The cheat sheet carries a "Change shortcuts…" button that opens a table of the window-wide actions; a key typed there replaces the default, a key already taken by another action is named as a conflict and cannot be saved, and the overrides are kept in the Preferences store under :data:`_KEYMAP_KEY` in Qt's portable spelling, so a keymap saved on one platform reads the same on the others. Keys that belong to a single screen (Annotate, Make Masks, the field browser) have separate editable rows and saved overrides, applied to both existing and new screens.
